notes: DRAFT for Jay's read and edit (L17-C, Jay t1031u Nov 16). Not for release until Jay approves. Same format as content/street-smarts/store-separated.json. Ages 10-13: a little more mature, still calm. Threat implied, never shown: the driver stays in the car, never opens the door, never grabs, and drives off. Every kid line is 8 words or fewer. Rewards: stars and the badge only, no power and no fight bonus (Jay Q6a). Secret word and Mom/Dad follow J11. Helpers: crossing guard and bus driver (both in uniform).
topic: A driver you don't know offers a ride from the bus stop

characters.note: An ordinary adult in an ordinary car. Friendly voice, not scary. Stays in the car. Never opens the door, never grabs, never threatens. Drives away when the player says no.
In a bright safety vest. Calm and kind. The safe helper here.
Mom or Dad (ui.json grownups). Calm, warm, never angry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {player} waits at the bus stop after school.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The bus is running late today.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A crossing guard and some kids are nearby.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Let's look around first, {player}.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Where is the safest place to wait?

choices.text: Near the other kids and the guard.
Off by the trees, out of sight.

spot-good.speaker: sensei
spot-good.text: Good spot. People can see you there.

spot-retry.speaker: sensei
spot-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

spot-retry.speaker: sensei
spot-retry.text: If you need help, who can see you?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A car slows and stops by the curb.

lines.speaker: driver
lines.text: Hey! {grownup} asked me to pick you up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {player} doesn't know this driver.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Do they know your family's secret word?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What do you do?

choices.text: Walk over to the car window.

ride-good.speaker: sensei
ride-good.text: Smart. Keep your distance from the car.

ride-retry-window.speaker: sensei
ride-retry-window.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

ride-retry-window.speaker: sensei
ride-retry-window.text: How close do you need to answer?

ride-retry-in.speaker: sensei
ride-retry-in.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

ride-retry-in.speaker: sensei
ride-retry-in.text: Knowing a name isn't the secret word.

ride-retry-in.speaker: sensei
ride-retry-in.text: Only safe grown-ups know your secret word.

lines.speaker: driver
lines.text: Come on, it's fine. Hop in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The driver keeps asking. What now?

choices.text: Say loudly, "NO! I don't know you!"

voice-good.speaker: narrator
voice-good.text: {player} steps back toward the crossing guard.

voice-retry.speaker: sensei
voice-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

voice-retry.speaker: sensei
voice-retry.text: A loud voice gets people to look.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Who do you tell?

choices.text: The bus driver, when the bus comes.

help-good.speaker: guard
help-good.text: Good noticing. I'll let your school know.

help-retry.speaker: sensei
help-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

help-retry.speaker: sensei
help-retry.text: Could that driver ask another kid tomorrow?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The bus pulls up, and {player} climbs on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At home, {player} tells {grownup} too.

lines.speaker: grownup
lines.text: I'm proud of you for telling me.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: What did you do that helped?

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: You waited where people could see you.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: You kept your distance and used your voice.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Then you told safe grown-ups.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Awareness is your first defense.

stars.rule: Best choice on the first try at spot, ride and help earns 1 star each (voice is required to continue, like the store). A retry still finishes and can be replayed for all 3 stars.

badge.name: Bus Stop Badge
badge.earned: You earned the Bus Stop Badge!
badge.book: Stayed aware, said no and told helpers.
badge.rule: Location set done: every scenario at this location with at least 2 stars (core-design section 12). Shows in the Book (L10).

townLight.line: The bus stop glows on the town map!
townLight.note: Looks only. The Bus Stop spot on the town map lights up when the badge is earned. No power.
